title: List the superhero names of those who have more than 10 superpowers and who
question: List the superhero names of those who have more than 10 superpowers and whose speed attribute value is among the top 3 highest.

prediction.sql:
WITH PowerCounts AS (
    SELECT T1."XCL_018" AS HeroID, COUNT(T2."XCL_013") AS PowerCount
    FROM superhero AS T1
    INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1."XCL_018" = T2."XCL_012"
    GROUP BY T1."XCL_018"
    HAVING COUNT(T2."XCL_013") > 10
),
SpeedRanked AS (
    SELECT T1."XCL_018" AS HeroID, T1."XCL_019" AS Name, T3."XCL_011" AS SpeedValue,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY T3."XCL_011" DESC) AS Rnk
    FROM superhero AS T1
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T3 ON T1."XCL_018" = T3."XCL_009"
    INNER JOIN attribute AS T4 ON T3."XCL_010" = T4."XCL_003"
    WHERE T4."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
      AND T1."XCL_018" IN (SELECT HeroID FROM PowerCounts)
)
SELECT SR.Name
FROM SpeedRanked AS SR
WHERE SR.Rnk <= 3
ORDER BY SR.Rnk

WITH PowerCounts AS (
    SELECT T1."XCL_018" AS HeroID, COUNT(T2."XCL_013") AS PowerCount
    FROM superhero AS T1
    INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1."XCL_018" = T2."XCL_012"
    GROUP BY T1."XCL_018"
    HAVING COUNT(T2."XCL_013") > 10
),
SpeedRanked AS (
    SELECT T1."XCL_018" AS HeroID, T1."XCL_019" AS Name, T3."XCL_011" AS SpeedValue,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY T3."XCL_011" DESC) AS Rnk
    FROM superhero AS T1
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T3 ON T1."XCL_018" = T3."XCL_009"
    INNER JOIN attribute AS T4 ON T3."XCL_010" = T4."XCL_003"
    WHERE T4."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
      AND T1."XCL_018" IN (SELECT HeroID FROM PowerCounts)
)
SELECT SR.Name
FROM SpeedRanked AS SR
WHERE SR.Rnk <= 3
ORDER BY SR.Rnk
